reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the Quarrendon Freight Lines door 6 duplicate arrivals is Thea Ramaswell. She's Quarrendon's Director of Yard Operations.

The source is Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, and Marcus is a member of that channel. Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 on the morning shift. In that example, one trailer showed up as two rows at 06:30 because the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him manually. Dana said she was looking into it.
